column1: # Omega portability table (omega-mv#596, slice R3). Checked by: make test-runtime-portability (tools/runtime_portability_check.sh).
# Columns, tab separated: file, class, reason, os_binding. Explained in docs/runtime/PORTABILITY.md.
# class: CHIP_SPECIFIC carries knowledge of the GB10 / Blackwell chip or of the driver interface that exposes it; PORTABLE carries neither.

# os_binding: FREESTANDING_PROVEN (a .c file in GPU_FS_SRCS, mk/omega-gpu-engine.mk, built by make gpu-engine-freestanding), NO_HOSTED_INCLUDE (no hosted header by include scan only; not linked freestanding), HOSTED_LIBC (includes stdio, stdlib, time, errno, math or pthread), LINUX_DRIVER (includes nvrm.h, m16_native.h or omega_gpu_platform_linux.h).

column3: reason

Instruction generators for the sm_121 kernels (vector add, matmul, the Qwen decode set); emits Blackwell machine code through the encoder. In the freestanding closure; the allocating generators and the printing self-test are hosted-only (docs/numeric/OMEGA_GPU_NATIVE_BOUNDARY.md section 3).
Blackwell IR opcodes and kernel-generator API; includes omega_blackwell_matmul.h.
Generates the single-launch decode attention kernel (sm_121 machine code, 8 query heads per KV head, head_dim 128).
Interface of the decode attention kernel generator; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the bf16 streaming GEMV (lm_head) as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the bf16 GEMV generator; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the decode glue kernels (residual add, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, expert combine, argmax) as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the decode glue kernel generators; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the FP8 block-scaled grouped GEMM for prefill as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the FP8 prefill GEMM generator; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the FP8 GEMV kernel family (MoE) as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the FP8 GEMV generator; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates FP8 GEMV variant 2 (row-pipelined) as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of FP8 GEMV variant 2; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_moe.h.
Generates the causal prefill attention kernel on tensor cores (HMMA, SHFL) as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the prefill attention generator; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the small device-resident prefill kernels (copy and friends) as sm_121 machine code through the omega_bw_em.h emitters.
Interface of the prefill helper kernels; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the on-chip router-logits and MoE-combine kernels as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the on-chip router and combine generators; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the native FP8 prefill kernels (activation quantiser, QMMA GEMM) as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the native FP8 prefill generators; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Encodes the FP8 tensor-core op QMMA.16832, patched in after the shared encoder (which lacks it); values come from an nvcc sm_121 oracle.
Describes the QMMA.16832.F32.E4M3.E4M3 encoding for sm_121.
Generates the MoE router kernel (RMSNorm, logits, softmax, top-8) as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the router kernel generator; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the tensor-core grouped FP8 GEMM v2 as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the tensor-core GEMM v2 generator; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates tensor-core kernels (HMMA.16816 fragment layout) as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the tensor-core kernel generators; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
Generates the ternary W2A8 GEMV as sm_121 machine code.
Interface of the ternary GEMV generator; includes omega_blackwell_codegen.h.
The sm_121 machine-code encoder: packs instructions into 16-byte words. OS-free (in the freestanding closure) but the words it writes are Blackwell's.
Encoder interface; OMEGA_BW_INSTRUCTION_BYTES is 16, the Blackwell instruction size.
The Linux backend of OmegaGpuBackend: calls m16_native_* and carries the GB10 compute-class setup words (class 0xcec0).
Declares the Blackwell GB10 backend function table for the engine core.
Milestone 17 and 18 qualification gates and a silicon vector-add demonstration on GB10; host tooling.
Entry points of the M17 and M18 GB10 qualification gates.
Plans the Blackwell matmul kernels; in the freestanding closure, but the kernel shapes are sm_121 tensor-core shapes.
Types of the Blackwell matmul kernel (OmegaBlackwellKernel) and its size limits.
Builds the 384-byte QMD launch descriptor (96 words) for Blackwell compute class 0xcec0. In the freestanding closure.
QMD layout: OMEGA_BW_QMD_BYTES 384, field evidence tiers (documented, observed, reverse engineered), shared-memory field per clcec0qmd.h.
Turns an Omega vector program into Blackwell code plus QMD plus constant bank. In the freestanding closure.
Realization interface; includes omega_blackwell_qmd.h and omega_blackwell_encoder.h.
The vector executor: allocates and submits through m16_native_* on the Linux driver; its setup words and launch methods are GB10's. Pinned by the M17 and M18 gates.
Launch constants and executor interface for GB10; includes the realize and matmul headers.
Private IR emitter helpers for the sm_121 tensor-core generators (scheduling rules proven on the chip).
Private emitters for the FP8 QMMA placeholders (sm_121).
Warp reconvergence regions (BSSY, BSYNC) for the Blackwell IR emitters.
Builds and launches its own sm_121 attention kernels (stall counts as nvcc writes them for sm_121) through the session. In the freestanding closure.
Attention API; its kernel type OmegaBlackwellKernel comes from omega_blackwell_matmul.h.
Launches the bf16 GEMV through a command list; uses the Blackwell bf16 generator.
bf16 GEMV API; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_bf16.h.
Records launches into one method stream using clcec0 method numbers (WAIT_FOR_IDLE 0x0110, SEND_PCAS_A 0x02b4), the compute-class setup words, and the completion tail with an L2 flush.
Command-list interface; documents the uncached marker page and the L2_FLUSH_DIRTY tail.
Code buffers keep a 2 KB tail after the last instruction because the SM instruction cache prefetches past it (omega#323; the cause on GB10 is INFERRED).
Launches the decode attention kernel from the Blackwell generator through a command list.
Decode attention API; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_attn.h.
Chains a whole decode token into one command list from Blackwell kernels.
Decode graph interface over the FP8, router, attention and bf16 GEMV APIs.
Generates and launches its own elementwise sm_121 kernels; still hosted (stdio, stdlib, time), outside the freestanding closure (boundary doc section 6).
Elementwise API; kernel type OmegaBlackwellKernel comes from omega_blackwell_matmul.h.
The engine state machine (open, validate, submit, verify, close, named failure steps). Builds in make gpu-engine-freestanding; errno and the default clock exist only in the hosted build.
Engine contract and OmegaGpuBackend function table; includes only stddef.h and stdint.h.
Bounded text formatter that replaces snprintf in the session. Builds in make gpu-engine-freestanding.
Formatter interface; includes only stddef.h.
Launches the FP8 GEMV through Blackwell generators and command lists, with GPU-cached weight buffers.
FP8 GEMV API; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_moe.h.
Launches the FP8 prefill GEMM through the session.
FP8 GEMM API; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_gemm.h.
Packs FP8 weights into the layout the sm_121 GEMV kernels read; host side.
libm-free double-precision log, exp and pow for host-side tables; plain arithmetic, no chip or OS call.
Interface of the libm-free host math; no includes.
Builds Blackwell matmul kernels, fills the QMD and launches; reports target_chip GB10. In the freestanding closure.
Public matmul entry point: bf16 in, f32 out, plain integer and pointer types; includes only stdbool.h, stddef.h and stdint.h.
Allocates GPU-cached weight buffers; relies on the GB10 rule that a write-once buffer the CPU never reads cannot hold a stale L2 line.
Documents the GPU-cached read-only weight invariant (nvos.h GPU_CACHEABLE: not coherent with CPU mappings).
Launches MoE matmul kernels from the Blackwell generators and the QMD builder.
MoE API surface over omega_gpu_matmul_api.h; no chip type in the header.
Prefill GEMM driver over the Blackwell tensor-core generators.
Prefill router and combine launcher over the Blackwell pfhost generators.
Prefill router and combine API; documents bit-exact sm_121 kernel semantics.
Platform contract checks, negotiation and handle table. Builds in make gpu-engine-freestanding.
The platform contract ABI 1.2: handles, buffers, services, refusals. Includes only stddef.h and stdint.h.
The Linux reference platform: nvrm_open and m16_native_create_channel on the NVIDIA open driver. Hosted only, outside the freestanding closure.
Declares the Linux driver platform; the implementation behind it is the Linux binding.
Launches the prefill attention kernel from the Blackwell generator on the session.
Prefill attention API; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_pattn.h.
Device-resident prefill: GPU-cached device buffers and a copy kernel, with the stale-L2 rules for GB10.
Documents the prefill memory policy: GPU-cached device-private buffers and L2_FLUSH_DIRTY.
Launches the router kernel through a command list.
Router API; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_router.h.
Serving reservation: counts and bounds what a session may allocate. Builds in make gpu-engine-freestanding.
Serving reservation interface; includes only stdint.h.

The persistent session over OmegaGpuPlatform. OS-free (in the freestanding closure) but carries GB10 constants: the compute-class setup words (class 0xcec0), the cache-invalidate method 0x021c, launch constants from omega_blackwell_submit.h.
Session interface in platform terms (OmegaGpuMem, handles); includes only omega_gpu_platform.h.
Launches the tensor-core GEMM through the session.
Tensor-core GEMM API; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_tc.h.
Launches the ternary GEMV with GPU-cached weights through a command list.
Ternary GEMV API; includes omega_blackwell_codegen_tern.h.
Bounded wait with a caller-supplied clock and hooks; no default clock in the freestanding build. Builds in make gpu-engine-freestanding.
Bounded wait interface; includes only stdbool.h and stdint.h.
